headline: Commercialise the enzyme-free single-molecule platform first as a research-use instrument for rare/low-abundance biomarker detection, proving superiority over bulk-average incumbents with named benchmarking partners, before using that credibility and revenue base to bridge into regulated diagnostics.

applications.application: Ultra-sensitive oncology biomarker discovery (rare circulating proteins, early-detection panels)
applications.rationale: All three peers (Refeyn, ONT, Depixus) built their initial commercial base on single-molecule sensitivity beating bulk methods for low-abundance targets; oncology is the highest-value, most fundable entry point.

applications.application: Neurology biomarker panels (neurodegenerative disease protein signatures)
applications.rationale: Oxford Nanopore's MATRIX CNS-tumour and VCGS ISO15189 path shows how a neurology/CNS beachhead can later anchor a clinical accreditation partnership.

applications.application: Drug-discovery target validation and hit-to-lead biomolecular interaction profiling
applications.rationale: Depixus built its research-use GTM entirely around pharma target validation, positioning MAGNA One head-to-head against SPR/Biacore for interaction data at single-molecule resolution.

applications.application: Multi-modal single-run DNA/RNA/protein biomarker panels ('one-platform' multiomic pitch)
applications.rationale: Refeyn and ONT both differentiate on replacing multiple bulk assays with one richer single-molecule readout; Proteins.1's cross-biomolecule capability is a natural extension of this positioning.

applications.application: Biopharma QC/characterization (proteins, antibodies, viral vectors) as a later expansion
applications.rationale: Refeyn's trajectory from academic protein characterization into AAV/antibody GMP QC shows a natural second wave once instruments and software modules mature.

market_route.step: Anchor scientific credibility on VTT IP and named academic authority
market_route.detail: Publish the seminal enzyme-free physics paper and align a recognized academic co-founder/authority figure with the platform, mirroring Refeyn (Kukura), ONT, and Depixus (Croquette/Bensimon) precedents to build early trust.

market_route.step: Publish head-to-head benchmarking studies against incumbents
market_route.detail: Run and publish comparisons vs. Simoa, ELISA, mass spectrometry, SPR and AUC with named CRO/pharma/academic partners, following Refeyn's ABL Europe and Depixus's SPR-comparison playbooks to convert skepticism into adoption.

market_route.step: Launch a tiered benchtop instrument line for research-use-only markets
market_route.detail: Offer an entry-level and an automated/higher-throughput configuration from day one (as with Refeyn's TwoMP/SamuxMP and ONT's pocket-to-production scaling), targeting academic core facilities and CROs first.

market_route.step: Fund via a blended non-dilutive + staged dilutive path
market_route.detail: Combine EU/Horizon and national deep-tech grants with seed and Series A/B rounds from specialist life-science/deep-tech investors (as all three peers did), preserving runway for multi-year hardware/chemistry iteration.

market_route.step: Build application-specific software modules and recruit commercial leadership
market_route.detail: Develop workflow-specific analysis modules per biomarker class (DNA/RNA/protein), and bring in a life-sciences-tools commercial executive with prior single-molecule/instrument scaling experience once core science is validated.

market_route.step: Secure a flagship clinical/diagnostics partnership as the bridge to regulated use
market_route.detail: After building a research-use revenue base and reference customers, pursue an ISO15189-style accreditation partnership or landmark clinical lab collaboration (ONT/VCGS/MATRIX model) to move from research tool to regulated diagnostic.

sequence: First, establish scientific credibility through VTT-anchored IP, a named academic authority, and published benchmarking data against gold-standard incumbents (ELISA, mass spec, Simoa, SPR, AUC). Simultaneously launch a tiered research-use instrument (entry and automated versions) into academic core facilities, CROs, and pharma R&D for oncology, neurology, and drug-discovery target-validation applications, funded through a blended grant-plus-staged-VC path. As adoption and reference data accumulate, layer in application-specific software modules and recruit an experienced life-sciences-tools commercial leader to scale go-to-market and expand into pharma QC/characterization use cases. Only once a solid research-use revenue base and published validation record exist should Proteins.1 pursue a landmark clinical/diagnostics partnership (e.g., ISO15189 accreditation) as the deliberate bridge into regulated diagnostics, rather than attempting clinical entry prematurely.
